ATHENS HARBOR (PIRAEUS)   
If arriving by boat: approaching the coast, you see 
that it is similar to that of New England, with 
oddly-shaped inlets, gulfs, and headlands. But New 
England is cool, moist, and green; here, luxurious 
golden warmth pervades everything.  The Greek republic, only 
seven years old, totters under the hardships of the worldwide 
depression. The people are eager for tourists, as foreign money is 
much needed. Your ship docks at the gaily-decorated harbor at 
Piraeus. Higher up in the hills beyond, Athens gleams beneath
